description: This file contains API client functions and data type definitions for interacting with HR management backend endpoints, including employees, leaves, attendance, audit logs, holidays, and payroll.

methods.name: listEmployees
methods.description: Fetches a list of employees with optional pagination.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Submits a leave request for an employee.

methods.name: listLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: decideLeave
methods.description: Approves or rejects a leave request.

methods.name: myLeaveBalances
methods.description: Fetches the leave balances for the current user.

methods.name: listAttendanceSessions
methods.description: Lists attendance sessions within a date range.

methods.name: listHolidays
methods.description: Lists holidays within a date range.
